content:
The San Diego Sphere | Full Resolution 12-Minute Tape

#ufotwitter

It presents the original, full-resolution footage (about 12 minutes long) of a silvery metallic sphere captured in 2014 over a backyard in San Diego, California, by witness Rick Ybarra a former DoD employee.

Key details from the video and description:

The object is described as roughly 4-6 feet in diameter, hovering around 400 feet up.

It has a shiny/metallic look with three rod-like appendages sticking out.

It shows stop/start movements and some irregular motion that doesn't perfectly match the wind (around the 8:15–9:30 mark in the tape), though the witness initially thought it might be a balloon.

The video includes an intro and then dives straight into the raw handheld footage.

Please tell me what is the probability that out of all the people on the planet, it was a former employee of the U.S. Department of Defense who filmed it.
